decisions.decision: Extract models and RecommendationEngine into SystemCompanion.Core (net10.0) referenced by the app and a new SystemCompanion.Tests xUnit project
decisions.why: Lets the advice engine be tested without WinUI or the Windows App SDK runtime, which the constitution requires
decisions.rejected: Test project referencing the WinUI app project, which needs XAML compilation and an SDK bootstrap in the test host

decisions.decision: Inject screenshot-check BIOS values into RecommendationEngine as a name-to-label dictionary
decisions.why: Removes the engine's static AppData and file-layout coupling with a smaller change than an interface
decisions.rejected: Injecting a service interface with one implementation, or moving AppData into the library

decisions.decision: discover-system.ps1 writes the history copy itself, after the current snapshot
decisions.why: One writer covers the refresh script, the in-app rescan and a manual scan, with no race
decisions.rejected: Having the app copy the file, which leaves manual scans with no history and adds a second writer

decisions.decision: On a same-minute collision append a counter suffix to the pinned file name
decisions.why: Keeps every reading while preserving the pinned pattern for the normal case
decisions.rejected: Overwriting the entry (loses data) or always adding seconds (changes the pinned pattern everywhere)

decisions.decision: Order history entries by the timestamp inside each file, never by file name
decisions.why: Clock changes and counter suffixes break name order while the recorded time stays honest
decisions.rejected: Ordering by file name or by file write time

decisions.decision: Drive the comparison from a declared table of compared values with a per-row direction
decisions.why: Diffing arbitrary JSON reports bookkeeping and cannot tell an improvement from a decline

decisions.decision: Run the scan by starting powershell.exe with -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File
decisions.why: Reuses the verified script with no arguments, no profile interference and no console window
decisions.rejected: Reimplementing collection in C#, which duplicates a verified script

decisions.decision: Hold the supported firmware tag as FirmwareReference.SupportedTag in Core
decisions.why: One testable constant that cannot drift from the value the spec pins
decisions.rejected: Reading the tag from the reference data files at startup

decisions.decision: AppData prefers the repository Data folder over the copy beside the exe
decisions.why: The scan script writes Data/current and Data/history in the repository, so the app must read the same folder for a rescan to be visible
decisions.rejected: Passing an output path to the script, which still leaves history in the repository folder

decisions.decision: A value unknown on both sides counts as Same, not CannotTell
decisions.why: Two readings that both fail to read a value have not changed, and treating them as changes floods the comparison
decisions.rejected: Checking Unknown before equality, which reports the whole table as changed

decisions.decision: ComparisonField carries an optional Rank so a rendered value can be ordered
decisions.why: Direction alone says which way is better but not which of two values is further along, which the improved/declined sentence needs
decisions.rejected: Parsing numbers inside HistoryService, which would duplicate the table's knowledge

decisions.decision: discover-system.ps1 resolves its default output path in the script body, and the app passes -OutputPath explicitly
decisions.why: Windows PowerShell 5.1 leaves $PSScriptRoot empty while it binds parameter defaults, so a bare -File run failed before doing anything
decisions.rejected: Relying on the app to pass the path, which would leave a manual run broken

plan.summary: Plan for three projects: extract logic to Core, add an xUnit suite, and add history, comparison, rescan and a firmware guard
plan.key_finding: RecommendationEngine is UI-free but reaches AppData directly through BestValue, so the engine can only be tested once that data is injected

specify.summary: History, comparison, the rescan action, a testable advice engine, the firmware warning and the fourth screen all ship

approach: Move the models and the advice engine into a new SystemCompanion.Core library with the screenshot-check data injected, then have one xUnit project exercise it. History is written by the existing scan script, ordered by the timestamp inside each file, and compared through a declared table of values that know which direction is better.
